description: This file defines the DeserializationException class in the Laminas\Diactoros\Exception namespace, which extends UnexpectedValueException and provides static factory methods for different deserialization error scenarios.

classes.name: DeserializationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling deserialization-related errors in Laminas Diactoros, providing static methods to throw specific error messages.

methods.name: forInvalidHeader
methods.description: Creates and throws a DeserializationException for invalid headers.

methods.name: forInvalidHeaderContinuation
methods.description: Creates and throws a DeserializationException for invalid header continuation.

methods.name: forRequestFromArray
methods.description: Creates a DeserializationException indicating failure to deserialize a request from an array, with previous Throwable attached.

methods.name: forResponseFromArray
methods.description: Creates a DeserializationException indicating failure to deserialize a response from an array, with previous Throwable attached.

methods.name: forUnexpectedCarriageReturn
methods.description: Creates and throws a DeserializationException for unexpected carriage return characters.

methods.name: forUnexpectedEndOfHeaders
methods.description: Creates and throws a DeserializationException for unexpected end of headers.

methods.name: forUnexpectedLineFeed
methods.description: Creates and throws a DeserializationException for unexpected line feed characters.
